name: Camden State Park, Upper Campground
waterfront_evidence: p3-424 (2026-11-11): ReserveMN facility 816 gives every Upper Campground unit (38E-63E, 64-82) '.5 mile' (41E '.8 mile') to water and tags none Water Front. Esri imagery at 44.3460,-95.9228 (half-width 300 m): the loops sit in woods at the edge of the Redwood River valley with prairie to the east; the nearest water is a wooded oxbow backwater ~100-150 m south-west of the west loop through continuous canopy, and the river itself is farther west beyond the railroad. No site has open ground to water -> not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: MN DNR Camden State Park record (overnight facilities: 'Electric Sites 47 sites: 21 in the upper campground and 26 in the lower campground'; 'Pull-Through Sites: Seven sites, 60-foot RV limit ... All are electric sites, located in the upper campground'; 'RV Length Limit 50-60 feet') + ReserveMN PlaceId 132 facility 816 'Upper Campground': 45 drive-in units, all AllowWebBooking true, pads 34-130 ft (only #64 under 40 ft) -> a real, publicly bookable drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. Its own campground road leaves the park road ~2.3 km south of the Lower Campground (site centroids 2,341 m apart).
note: Upper Campground of Camden State Park, in wooded loops at the edge of the Redwood River valley near Lynd, with the park's pull-through sites. The Lower Campground, by the river and the swimming beach, is about 2.3 km north. --Claude

sites.note: 21 electric sites (38E-63E) and 24 non-electric (43, 45, 46, 48, 49 and 64-82), pads 34-130 ft; seven electric pull-throughs take rigs to 60 ft.

facilities.note: Showers and flush toilets are seasonal; the dump station closes for winter.

fees.note: $24 a night for a drive-in site without electric; electric $34. The same on a Saturday.
